quality_flags.issue: The Government Printer scan data/legal-sources/library/amendments/incoming/20-1988-national-housing-development-authority-act-amendment.pdf (3 pp., no text layer) was read as images. body.heading: Insertion of new section 73A in Act No. 17 of 1979.
body.raw_text: 2. The following new section is hereby inserted immediately after section 73 of the National Housing Development Authority Act, No.17 of 1979 (hereinafter referred to as "the principal enactment") and shall have effect as section 73A of the principal enactment: " Transfer to the Authority of all assets &c., of the Department of National Housing.

body.heading: Retrospective effect of an Order made under section 73A.
body.raw_text: 3. Every Order made under section 73A of the principal enactment as inserted by section 2 of this Act shall be deemed to have come into force on the date on which the principal enactment come into operation and shall have the effect of transferring to End vesting in the National Housing Development Authority established by the principal enactment, with effect from that date all the assets, contracts and agreements specified in such Order.
